title: E-mail identity pivots and per-account breach names (batch p2-G04-1)
owner: batch p2-G04-1 (github_email_pivot, gravatar, hibp_account, leakcheck_public, lunar_domain_exposure, xposedornot, xposedornot_domain, xposedornot_domain_breaches; rule p2g04_breach_merge)
description: Names of the G04 e-mail/breach batch. Breach modules also emit the core/pack names breaches, breach_count, breach_data_classes, breach_records, first_seen_breach, breach_hit_count and generic_address (pack_breach.json) that the P146 pack reads.

attributes.github_accounts: GitHub accounts linked to an e-mail by an EXACT commit-author or public-profile e-mail match: list of {login, user_id, profile_url, basis commit_author | profile_email | noreply, commits, repos, commit_urls (max 5), first_seen, last_seen, verified_commit, confidence}: no names, bios, locations or followers
attributes.github_commit_search: GitHub commit search by author e-mail summary {total_count, exact_matches, unlinked_commits, unlinked_repos, discarded_non_exact, placeholder_logins, incomplete}: fuzzy hits are discarded, commits not linked to an account are context only
attributes.gravatar_profile: public Gravatar profile, minimised: {display_name, profile_url, avatar_hash, avatar_sha256 (file hash of the avatar image, for hash-equality correlation only), verified_accounts [{service, label, url, username}], links [{label, url}]}; location, bio, job, company and contact data are never kept
attributes.avatar_hash: Gravatar avatar hash (the SHA-256 or MD5 id in avatar URLs): avatar-reuse correlation by hash equality only, never image or face analysis
attributes.pastes: list of paste METADATA {source, id, date, email_count} listing the entity (the paste content is never fetched)
attributes.paste_count: int: number of pastes listing the entity
attributes.breach_risk: provider risk summary of an address's breach exposure {label, score, provider, note}: context only, never an exposure score for third-party addresses
attributes.service_breach_records: breaches of the service at this domain from a breach catalogue other than HIBP (XposedOrNot): list of {name, breach_date, data_classes, records, password_form, sensitive, verified, wording} - this service was breached, not accounts at this domain
attributes.domain_exposure: 12-month aggregate exposure card of a domain {period, totals (events, infostealer, data breach, employee, client, first/last seen), stealer_families, operating_systems, antivirus, months, breach_sources, caveats, provider}: counts only, never records; confidential case data (TLP:AMBER minimum)
attributes.own_domain_breaches: breached addresses of a verified own domain {addresses (count), breaches [{name, addresses}], years, provider}: counts per breach; the addresses themselves are listed only as analyst-selected pivots

tags.confidential: confidential case data (minimum TLP:AMBER): shown in AMBER-marked sections, excluded from CLEAR/GREEN exports and shareable reports

relations.domain_breach_address: own domain -> one of its addresses listed by an own-domain breach search (XposedOrNot domain-breaches): analyst selection required, never auto-expanded
